dvids.title: U.S. Destroys 5 IRGC Tankers After Iran Targets Another American Warship
dvids.desc: U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces destroyed five Iranian crude oil carriers, Sept. 8, after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targeted a U.S. Navy warship with ballistic missiles twice over the past two days. (U.S. Central Command video)

dvids.title: U.S. Destroys 5 IRGC Tankers After Iran Targets Another American Warship
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces destroyed five Iranian crude oil carriers, Sept. 8, after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targeted a U.S. Navy warship with ballistic missiles twice over the past two days.
